name: Banana Kush
summary: **Banana Kush** is a [[kind:cultivar|hybrid]] bred by Crockett Family Farms in Northern California, crossing [[ghost-og|Ghost OG]] with a [[skunk-haze|Skunk-Haze]] line dating to the early 1970s. The breeder's original name for it, Banana, gave way to Banana Kush among growers. It spread through West Coast dispensaries and reached wider distribution by the mid-2010s.
